jobs.description:
Are you a skilled technician with experience in engines or power systems? Do you enjoy working on complex equipment and making sure everything runs smoothly? For a location in Klundert, we are looking for a Power Technician who wants to work in a dynamic and international environment. You will receive an attractive salary, excellent benefits, and plenty of opportunities to grow. Interested? Read on and apply today!

Manpower is looking for a Power Technician for a company based in Klundert.

As a Power Technician, you are responsible for maintaining and preparing a reliable rental fleet. You work with generators, hybrid systems, battery packs, compressors, and related equipment. You ensure that all equipment is ready for use and meets customer requirements.

Your tasks include:

    - Preparing work and identifying required parts and materials
    
- Performing standard maintenance according to guidelines
    
- Testing equipment and troubleshooting malfunctions
    
- Customizing equipment based on customer specifications
    
- Maintaining timesheets and service reports
    
- Ensuring equipment complies with QHSE guidelines

What’s in it for you

    - Gross monthly salary between €3,500 and €4,200 (depending on experience)
    
- Direct contract with the employer
    
- Bonus opportunity of 7.5% based on performance
    
- 8% holiday allowance
    
- 37 vacation days, including ADV days
    
- Pension scheme with a 5% employee contribution
    
- Opportunities for training, certifications, and career growth
    
- Work in a stable, international organization

    - Experience as a service or breakdown mechanic for heavy engines or similar
    
- Technical background in commercial vehicles or power systems
    
- Good command of Dutch (spoken and written) and understanding of English
    
- Own transportation
    
- Proactive and problem-solving mindset

Ready to take the next step as a Power Technician in Klundert? Apply today and we will contact you soon to discuss the opportunities!

As a reach truck driver, you are an important part of the warehouse. You help make sure everything runs smoothly. You will work with a team leader, two assistants, and a rotating group of reach truck drivers and order pickers. Each day starts with a short meeting to go over tasks and priorities so everyone knows what to do.

In this job, you pick pallets and orders quickly and accurately to meet daily targets. You also keep stock levels correct by refilling shelves. Scanning and preparing orders is part of your routine, making sure everything is correct and ready for shipping.

You keep the warehouse organized, safe, and easy to work in. Sometimes you also help with other tasks, like case picking or working with Kardex cabinets and Flow Racks.

This job is flexible: you will work rotating shifts from 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM and 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM on alternating weeks.

- A valid reach truck certificate
- Digital skills: experience with ASTRO WMS is a plus, but general computer proficiency is sufficient
- Proficiency in English; Dutch is a plus but not required
- Flexibility to work rotating shifts from 7:00‑16:00 and 10:00‑19:00 (alternating weeks)

Are you passionate about sports and looking for an exciting career in logistics? Join our dynamic team at Decathlon's ultra-modern warehouse in Tilburg! We're seeking enthusiastic individuals to help manage our international distribution center, serving stores and customers across multiple European countries.

Your role in our team
As a Logistics Employee at Decathlon, you'll be part of a dedicated team responsible for ensuring smooth operations in our state-of-the-art facility. Your main duties will include:

- Processing orders efficiently using advanced robotic systems

- Collaborating with team members to meet daily goals and targets

- Maintaining high standards of accuracy and safety in all operational processes

- Opportunity to develop into specialized roles such as 'captain' or 'trainer'

What we offer
At Decathlon, we value our employees and offer a range of benefits to support your growth and well-being:

- Competitive starting salary of €2338.27 per month (38-hour week), with potential for monthly bonuses

- 8% holiday pay and 24 vacation days

- 20% discount on Decathlon products

- Comprehensive training and development opportunities

- Employee share ownership program

- Travel expense reimbursement (100% for bike/public transport, 50% for car up to 30km)

- Access to sports coaching and wellness platforms

- Regular team events and outings

What we're looking for
The ideal candidate for this role will possess:

- A passion for sports and an active lifestyle

- Flexibility to work 32-38 hours per week, including one weekend day

- Availability for various shifts (morning, afternoon/evening, night)

- Excellent command of English

- Valid Dutch passport/visa/work permit

- Residence within a 30-minute radius of our Tilburg warehouse

- Alignment with our core values: vitality, generosity, responsibility, and authenticity

About Decathlon
Decathlon is a global leader in sporting goods retail, committed to making sports accessible to all.

As a packing employee, you ensure that the produced snacks are properly packed. This is done manually. The products you will be packing are mainly spring rolls. You will also carry out quality checks and package the product. If necessary, you may be assigned to different departments or production lines.

Example shift times are from 07:15 to 15:15, from 15:15 to 23:15, and from 23:15 to 07:15.

- Able to carry out physically demanding tasks
- Good command of the Dutch or English language
- Flexible attitude regarding shifts

Are you ready for a new challenge in a friendly and supportive work environment where your focus on quality really matters? Your future employer is looking for enthusiastic team players to join the packing department.

As a packer, you’ll work closely with a cheerful and tight-knit team to package delicious snacks with care and precision. You’ll make sure that every product is neatly packed, maintaining the high standards customers expect. With your sharp eye for detail, you’ll inspect the products and ensure that only top-quality items leave the factory.

You’ll be working in two shifts: the morning shift runs from 07:00 to 15:30, and the evening shift from 15:30 to 00:00. Both dutch and English speakers are welcome here! You’ll be joining a positive team where teamwork and a pleasant atmosphere are key.

You’ll start with an average monthly salary of € 2.968,90 based on a 37,5-hour workweek. Since you’ll be working in shifts, your actual earnings may vary. The more shift hours you work, the more you’ll earn. As you gain experience and grow in the role, your salary can increase up to a maximum of €3.276,64 per month.

So what are you waiting for? Apply today! 

- You’re a true go-getter: love working with your hands and always strive for perfection? You’ll fit right in with our team
- You have experience in production or with food
- Oudkarspel is your working base: you can independently commute to our location and are ready to get started

Are you technically inclined and do you enjoy working with machinery? As a Maintenance Technician, you ensure that our production machines keep running optimally. You perform maintenance tasks, troubleshoot electrical and mechanical faults, and make sure machines are quickly operational again. Additionally, you replace and overhaul components where necessary, working closely with operators and production colleagues. You also proactively share ideas to improve machinery and processes. You will join a modern, high-tech manufacturing environment where engineering, quality, and teamwork are central. 
What we offer - A great monthly salary! - 27 vakantiedagen en 13 ATV dagen. - Day shift work! - Opportunities for career growth! - Prospect of a permanent contract. - Guaranteed full-time hours in day shifts. 
Who you are 
Does this sound like you?:: - A completed technical education at MBO-4 level; - 1 year of relevant work experience within a manufacturing or maintenance environment; - Knowledge of technical drawings and schematics; - Good command of the Dutch or English languages; - In possession of Basic VCA and NEN 3140 certificates, or willing to obtain these; - Experience with Microsoft Office; - An independent working attitude combined with a strong team mentality. 
What will you do 
As a Maintenance Technician, you will be engaged in both electrical and mechanical work. Your responsibilities include: - Performing preventive maintenance on production machinery and equipment; - Overhauling and replacing machine components; - Analyzing and troubleshooting complex faults; - Managing and monitoring utilities and related installations; - Performing installation work and machine set-ups; - Identifying areas for improvement and proposing optimizations; - Drafting, managing, and updat...

Are you someone who enjoys going to the gym during the day or prefers doing your grocery shopping when it's nice and quiet? Then a career as a Line Operator could be exactly what you're looking for!

Working in shifts gives you a flexible schedule, making it feel like you have an extra day off every week. Sounds good, right?

As a line operator, you are responsible for ensuring the production process runs smoothly in a modern manufacturing environment. You will set up, operate, and monitor production machines and equipment to ensure production is carried out safely, efficiently, and in line with quality standards.

You will keep a close eye on the production process, identify any irregularities, and take action when needed. You'll also troubleshoot minor machine issues independently and perform first-line maintenance to keep operations running smoothly. In addition, you will carry out quality inspections and accurately record production data.

In this role, you'll work closely with colleagues from production, logistics, and the technical department. Maintaining high standards of hygiene, safety, and quality is an essential part of the job and the working environment.

- Accurate and quality-conscious
- Results-driven, flexible, and proactive
- A team player
- Good command of Dutch or English

- A motivation letter is requiered

You will exercise the rights and obligations as the legal owner of the affiliated companies (about 90) in the Europe region on behalf of Siemens Energy and represent the interests of the shareholder function to the management of the companies. The team consists of around 7, 8 people (shareholder controllers, legat, tax, accounting, support). Because of the workload and the projects Siemens is looking for extra capacity to help M&A activitities, divestments and special projects. 

How You'll Make an Impact:

• Assume the rights and obligations as the legal owner of the affiliated companies in the Europe region on behalf of Siemens Energy
• Represent the interests of the shareholder function to the management of the companies
• Design and optimize corporate shareholding structures and implement them in practice in a goal-oriented manner
• Analyze financial key figures and balance sheet structures, develop proposals to optimize the capital structures of the companies, and ensure compliance with guidelines for dividend payments
• Participate as a leader of relevant workstreams in carve-out and integration projects, as well as the corporate implementation of foundations, mergers, and liquidations within the framework of M&A projects
• Actively shape the digital transformation of the shareholder function within Siemens Energy

What You Bring:

• University degree or equivalent experience in business administration or similar fields
• Experience in shareholder controlling and reporting, preferably also in a commercial operational function in exchange with regional units
• Experience in project and process management for small to medium-sized projects, as well as first experience in leading (virtual) teams
• Experience in implementing digital financial processes
• Full Business proficiency in English. Basis knowlegde of Dutch and German is a plus.

At UPS, you’ll have the chance to work in a modern warehouse environment where no two days are the same. You and your new colleagues make sure that all parcels are sorted and end up at the right address. You’ll earn €15 per hour plus a shift allowance (depending on the shift). Read on to find out more, we’d love to tell you all about it!

jobs.occupation: CE Truck Driver | Recycling Container Transport | Heerenveen
jobs.description:
As a CE Truck Driver, you will transport sea containers filled with recycling materials. You will be responsible for the safe and timely delivery of your loads while representing the company professionally at customers, ports and container terminals.
Your responsibilities include:
• Transporting recycling materials in sea containers.
• Transporting loads throughout the Netherlands, Belgium and Germany.
• Collecting and delivering containers at ports, terminals and customer locations.
• Completing transport documents accurately.
• Maintaining contact with planners, terminals and customers.
• Taking good care of your truck, trailer and cargo.
• Working from Monday to Friday with overnight stays in the truck.
• Starting your trips from Heerenveen.

Functie-eisen:
- Valid CE driving licence.
• Valid Code 95.
• Valid digital driver card.
• Experience with container transport is an advantage.
• Experience driving to and from ports and container terminals is a plus.
• A responsible and independent working attitude.
• Willingness to stay overnight in the truck during the working week.
• Professional and customer-friendly attitude.
• Careful handling of vehicles, cargo and transport documents.
• You can communicate in either Dutch or English. English-speaking drivers are encouraged to apply.Apply now!
Would you like to drive modern trucks, transport recycling materials in sea containers and work for a professional transport company with clear agreements and excellent working conditions? Apply today and become part of our team!

Samenvatting Step into the fast-paced world of logistics as an Orderpicker in Zoetermeer area?. This role gives you hands-on experience, growth opportunities, and a supportive team environment. If you’re looking for a fresh start and want to develop real skills, this is your chance. Good work!Over de functieAs an Orderpicker in Zoetermeer area, you play a crucial role in the logistics process. Using a handheld scanner, you make sure every item is picked accurately and efficiently. You’ll also help pack orders, label shipments, and occasionally assist with unloading goods from trucks. The work environment is dynamic and active, with a focus on teamwork and precision. You’ll be on your feet, moving around the warehouse, and working with colleagues to meet daily targets.
- Picking and collecting products in the warehouse using a handheld scanner and EPT
- Labeling and preparing orders for shipment
- Assisting with unloading deliveries and organizing goods
- Maintaining a clean and safe work environment
- Communicating clearly with your team to meet targets

You work Monday to Friday, with shifts between 7:00 and 16:00. Some flexibility during busy periods may be required.
Over het bedrijf
Within this logistics company in Zoetermeer area, you’ll find a team that values efficiency, reliability, and good communication. The company specializes in fast and accurate order processing for clients across the region, using modern systems and a well-organized warehouse. You’ll work alongside colleagues who are supportive and eager to help new team members settle in. The atmosphere is open, with a mix of experienced staff and newcomers, and there’s always music playing to keep the energy up. If you’re looking for a place where you can learn, grow, and be part of a close-knit team, this is it.
